metadata.description: RIXS study of NiPS3 at Ni L-edge to discover Hund's exciton
metadata.scientific_goal: Infer exciton energy from RIXS measurements

reference_paper.title: Magnetically propagating Hund's exciton in van der Waals antiferromagnet NiPS3
reference_paper.authors: He, W., Shen, Y., Wohlfeld, K., Sears, J., Li, J., Pelliciari, J., et al.

experimental_components.description: 2.0m long Elliptically Polarizing Undulator (EPU49) for SIX beamline at NSLS2

physical_properties.flux: ~10^13 photons/sec (typical for NSLS2 3 GeV ring at 400 mA)
physical_properties.source_size: ~10 μm H × ~5 μm V (typical NSLS2 source size)

experimental_functions: Provide tunable incident energy (853.4 eV for Ni L-edge)
experimental_components.notes: NSLS2 ring operated at 3 GeV with 400 mA current

experimental_functions: Select incident photon energy (853.4 eV - Ni L3 edge)
Reduce energy bandwidth for high-resolution RIXS

experimental_components.description: Kirkpatrick-Baez mirrors or similar focusing optics
experimental_functions: Increase photon density at sample position
Cool sample below TN=155 K to study antiferromagnetic state
experimental_components.notes: Temperature 40 K << TN=155 K ensures antiferromagnetic order

experimental_components.description: Van der Waals antiferromagnetic NiPS3 crystal - electronic excitations UNKNOWN

physical_properties.magnetic_order: KNOWN: Antiferromagnetic zigzag chains, TN=155 K

experimental_components.gap_closure_goal: Infer exciton energy and Hund's exchange interaction from RIXS spectral data (sample→detector measurements)

constraints.resonance_condition: Maximum exciton intensity at Ni L3 edge (~853 eV)

experimental_components.notes: THIS IS SYSTEM D - THE KNOWLEDGE GAP. Exciton properties are UNKNOWN and will be inferred from RIXS measurements.

experimental_components.description: Ultra-high-resolution soft X-ray RIXS spectrometer at SIX beamline

physical_properties.energy_resolution: 14 meV at 1000 eV (total), ~17 meV at 853 eV (estimate)

experimental_functions: Measure inelastically scattered X-ray energy (Ef = Ei - ΔE)
Resolve energy loss ΔE with ~17 meV resolution
Detect scattered X-rays at various angles (k-space mapping)
Record RIXS spectra as function of energy loss

measured_observables.primary_observable: RIXS intensity I(Ei, ΔE, k) as function of energy loss ΔE

experimental_components.notes: THIS IS THE CRITICAL MEASUREMENT - RIXS spectra encode exciton energy and dispersion

physical_interactions.description: Undulator generates broad-spectrum soft X-rays, monochromator selects 853.4 eV

physical_interactions.physical_mechanism: X-ray absorption and RIXS excitation (Ni L3 edge resonance)
physical_interactions.interaction_strength: Flux at sample ~10^11-10^12 ph/s (after focusing losses)
physical_interactions.description: 853.4 eV X-rays excite Ni 2p → 3d transitions, creating excitons and other excitations

physical_interactions.interaction_strength: Thermal conductivity sets sample at T=40 K
physical_interactions.description: Cryostat cools sample to 40 K, ensuring antiferromagnetic order (TN=155 K)

physical_interactions.physical_mechanism: Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) - Ni 2p3d excitations with energy loss
physical_interactions.interaction_strength: RIXS cross-section ~10^-26 cm^2 (typical), scattered intensity I(ΔE)

measured_data.exciton_dispersion: Maps as function of scattering angle (k-space)
measured_data.exciton_magnon_offset: ~1.4 eV (exciton appears 1.4 eV above double-magnon energy)
measured_data.spectral_width: ~100-200 meV FWHM (exciton lifetime broadening + instrumental resolution)

physical_interactions.description: THIS IS THE CRITICAL DATA - RIXS measures exciton energy loss of 1.47 eV. This encodes System D electronic properties.

measured_observables: RIXS intensity I(ΔE) vs energy loss - shows peak at ΔE=1.47 eV
gap_closure_configuration.matrix_formulation: Infer System D (exciton energy) from measured D→E interaction (RIXS spectrum) given known A, B, C, E
gap_closure_configuration.expected_outcome: Gap closure should propose exciton energy ~1.47 eV and Hund's exchange ~1.4 eV
